notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, HLAinteger32BE, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and federate configuration. A monitor subscribes to HLAexceptionReporting, directly requests its standard-MIM value, and verifies the conditional reliable reflection after the subject changes and restores its public Exception Reporting switch. It does not generate service exceptions or depend on provider-specific headers, names, registries, or internal APIs.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador federation lifecycle, standard-MIM object-class subscription and attribute-value requests, Exception Reporting switch getter/setter, and FederateAmbassador reflection callback
